en: Look to the sky, and the wide-open sea
The hand of the Lord has made all we see
Though clouds may come and darken the sun Still God’s great purpose rules over all things

ko: 모두 고개를 들고 어둔 마음을 열어
en: Lift up your eyes, open your heartBehold the mighty power of our Lord

ko: 너와 나 지으신 주의 놀라운 손길
우리 다 함께 주를 찬양해 찬양해
en: You and I, formed by His wondrous hand Together we worship, we lift His name
All creation in the heavens and earth
Bow in reverence and humble praise
Before the majesty of our great King

ko: 들에 핀 꽃을 보라 하늘을 나는 새도
en: See the flowers blooming out in the field
See the birds flying high in the sky
They are all the work of the Lord’s great hands
He who made and governs everything
Even when storms cover the land
Still God’s deep wisdom holds all in His plan
